changes.text: The keyboard focus ring on a page button is a solid inset `--ss-primary` ring (was a `--ss-primary-soft` glow at about 1.5:1).
The dividers between cells use `border-inline-start` instead of `border-left`, so they follow the reversed row under `dir="rtl"`. Class names and markup are unchanged.

Styles ship in `dssoca/vanilla.css`, so plain-HTML pages can use the `.ss-pagination` markup (`.page`, `.nav-btn`, `.active`, `.ellipsis`) without Svelte. There is no `vanilla.js` behaviour: the page wires the buttons itself.

New component: windowed page controls with Previous / Next buttons, ellipses for hidden runs and `aria-current="page"` on the current page. Props: bindable `page`, `total`, `pageSize`, `pageCount`, `siblingCount`, `disabled`, `size` and `onchange`.
